chapter: Faith, Paris life and later years
title: Playing Tunis with Moody; the acoustics of the new theatre
summary: He had already seen colonial attitudes in North Africa when he and Moody played the Aero Club of France in Tunis, in a theatre where you could hear perfectly anywhere.

In Tunisia, in the city of Tunis.

So we arrived there, the Aero Club of France. They flew us there and we were going to play this concert, a fabulous brand new theater, and the architect had built this theater, that you could go anywhere in this theater, you could go to the toilet, and you could hear the orchestra just as plain as if you were on the stage, with no microphones.
And he told me. He said, -- well, Annie Ross was with us. He said, 'Go up to the top, as far as you can get up in the balcony,' and it was like I was sitting right in front of the stage.
